responses.text:
Built a group from the WC-85 drawing: group-cvtdwv-10 ("Group 1" in the scene), with parts Board, USB-A 1, USB-A 2 and Ethernet.

- Board: 85 × 56 × 1.6 mm plate, underside on Z = 0, centred on X/Y origin. Four Ø2.7 × through holes at X = -39 / 19 and Y = ±24.5 (58 × 49 mm pattern, 3.5 mm from edges).
- USB-A 1: 17 × 13 × 3 mm envelope at X 27.5–44.5, Y 13–26, resting on the board top.
- USB-A 2: 17 × 13 × 3 mm envelope at X 27.5–44.5, Y -5–8.
- Ethernet: 21 × 16 × 3 mm envelope at X 23.5–44.5, Y -26 to -10.
- Group bounds: X -42.5 to 44.5, Y -28 to 28, Z 0 to 4.6 mm; the connectors overhang the board edge by 2 mm, as drawn.

Checks: watertight, 0 open edges, 0 errors, 0 warnings; thinnest wall 1.6 mm; fits 220 × 220 × 250 mm as placed. Volume 9914 mm³.

Problems met:
- The drawing is labelled "WC-85 — fictional board, not a real product", not a Raspberry Pi 7. I modelled the drawing as given.
- Connector heights are not dimensioned. The 3 mm height is scaled from the side view and is an estimate; the real connectors are likely taller.
- Connectors are simple box envelopes, not detailed connector shapes.
- I can't add to the app's library from this MCP session. The group exists in the open project; it still needs to be added to the library from the app.
- The group is named "Group 1"; the tools here can't rename the group itself, only its parts.
